'''1997 Brisbane Open''' was a Star Wars CCG Open qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]]. Anyone could enter, and the winner earned a seat at the World Championship.<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Open qualifier (Australia)
* '''Date:''' 26 October 1997
* '''Site:''' McDonald's Coorparoo, Brisbane, Queensland
